contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantius II. This coin might possibly be a contemporary copy. Mint is uncertain, AD 353-361, Reece period 18). Reverse reads [FEL TEMP] REPARATIO. Reverse shows soldier spearing fallen horseman. Obverse legend reads DN CONSTA[...]. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Die axis is probably 12 o'clock, weight is 1.58g, diameter is 17.52mm
